newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India little traded on festival.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India little traded on festival.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts (GDRs) were little traded on Tuesday, with some market makers taking advantage of the closure of Indian exchanges to close their SEAQ quotes at midday.
"This is the third working day off for the BSE, so there is very little going on," said a trader.
Indian markets are closed for the Diwali festival.
Earlier, the Cazenove Indian GDR market closed just 0.17 points, or 0.24 percent higher, at 69.89.
The premium for Indian GDRs in the Cazenove index over the local market was 14.19 percent.
